title: GTA 6 Nominated for Game of the Year Before PS5 Reviews Are Released
description: GTA 6 has secured a Game of the Year nomination at The Game Awards 2026 before even receiving PS5 reviews, according to reports from Push Square.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Gets GOTY Nomination Ahead of PS5 Reviews

According to a report by gaming media outlet Push Square, the jury has spoken regarding the biggest event in the gaming industry. The Game Awards 2026 has just announced its nominees across all categories, and sticking out like a sore thumb is Rockstar Games' upcoming title, GTA 6.

## An Unprecedented Scenario

As reported, GTA 6 has managed to secure a nomination for Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2026 before the game has even launched and before any PS5 reviews have been released to the public. This unusual turn of events highlights the immense anticipation surrounding the title, setting it apart from traditional release and award cycles.

## Context and Industry Impact

The inclusion of a title without available reviews in a major category sparks interesting conversations about how the industry evaluates greatness and anticipation. While TGA nominations typically follow a specific timeline of releases, the sheer gravitational pull of the GTA franchise appears to have influenced the jury's verdict in a notable way.

## Editor's Take

Securing a Game of the Year nomination before reviews are even out is a testament to the unprecedented hype surrounding GTA 6. Whether this sets a new precedent for industry awards or remains an isolated anomaly, it proves that the game dominates the conversation well before launch.
